# Visual Learning Prompts in ChatGPT

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeMprilyH37/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Learn AI | Tools & Tips · **Saved:** 2026-10-22

## Summary

The creator demonstrates four prompt shortcuts used in ChatGPT to generate detailed visual diagrams for faster learning. These commands produce structured infographics including historical timelines, exploded views, anatomical diagrams, and cross-sections. Each format helps break down complex objects and concepts into labeled visual components.

## Transcript and on-screen text

These four codes will help you learn anything faster with visual explanations. The first one is timeline. Enter timeline and then a topic and it will come back to you with a phase by phase chart. I use AI as the topic. Next is explode view plus the name of an object. This gives you a page showing the components arranged according to their actual position. I used a TV remote as the subject. The next one is anatomy. Enter anatomy followed by a body part and you will get an anatomical illustration of that body part. I used foot as the body part. The last one is cross section. ChatGPT will show you a cutaway diagram of what's actually inside an object. I used a cruise liner as the object. For full sized images along with their prompts, comment codes and I'll send you a PDF. Oh, and hit follow and save this video for later. Comment CODES. Follow & Save.

## Caption

These four codes will help you learn anything faster. This is the second episode in a series.

When trying to learn about something complicated, very often a diagram can explain better than wards. Creating such diagrams is exactly what these codes are for.

Use them, and you’ll know what I mean. To get a PDF,mentioning the codes and showing the diagrams that they create, comment CODES and I will send you a DM with a link to it.
